def: A contiguous sequence of n tokens or words, such as a bigram (n = 2) or trigram (n = 3); also the classic language model that predicts the next word from n-gram counts.
practice: Still common in LLM work: BLEU and ROUGE count n-gram overlap, decontamination checks look for long n-gram matches, and prompt lookup decoding drafts tokens by copying n-grams from the prompt.
